review.limitations: All changes are limited to adding CSS class names for responsiveness; no implementation details, tests, or backend dependencies are shown. No tier 3 systemic benefit demonstrated.
review.reason: These hunks demonstrate a bounded UI improvement: making facet rails and associated panels stack vertically rather than horizontally on small screens. This improves accessibility and prevents horizontal scrolling without requiring backend or query-layer changes. The implementation and relevant checks are visible, supporting a Tier 2 assessment.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog users who view logs, traces, or other dashboard views that include facet rails, especially those using smaller devices or constrained layouts.
review.uncertainty: Only frontend behavior is shown; actual user benefit depends on whether this layout change resolves real usability issues in production.
